title: Demailly's Inequality for Finite Sets of Points in Positive Characteristic
summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, $n\ge1$, and let $X\subset \mathbb P^n_k$ be a finite nonempty set of distinct points with the defining ideal $I=I(X)$. We give a proof of Demailly's inequality in positive characteristic. The argument is based on the Frobenius--Hasse derivative method used in this context by Hà and Sivakumar.
